htaccess.blokas:
# BEGIN PS Botu uztvara (S1723, 2026-09-26): filtru/add-to-cart GET be ps_js slapuko -> 403 be PHP (botu sargo taisykle Apache lygyje)
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
RewriteEngine On
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_METHOD} ^GET$
RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} (^|&)(yith_wcan|filter_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+|query_type_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+|add-to-cart)= [NC]
RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} !(^|&)ps_[A-Za-z0-9_]+= [NC]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/(kasa|krepselis|paskyra|wp-json|wp-admin|wp-login\.php|feed) [NC]
RewriteCond %{HTTP_COOKIE} !(^|;\s*)ps_js=1 [NC]
RewriteCond %{HTTP_COOKIE} !wordpress_logged_in_ [NC]
RewriteRule ^ - [F,L]
# S1788 (2026-10-19): Tencent Cloud botu ferma AS132203 43.172.0.0/15 -> 403
RewriteCond %{REMOTE_ADDR} ^43\.17[23]\.
RewriteRule ^ - [F,L]
# S1788: krepselio remove_item be WC sesijos slapuko -> 403 (tikras pirkejas slapuka turi)
RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} (^|&)remove_item= [NC]
RewriteCond %{HTTP_COOKIE} !wp_woocommerce_session_ [NC]
RewriteRule ^ - [F,L]
</IfModule>
# END PS Botu uztvara
